pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is meat kept out of a compost heap? (1 mark)
   A. It makes the compost too dry
   B. It attracts rats and flies and smells bad
   C. It kills the soil
   D. It turns into plastic

2. What are germs? (1 mark)
   A. Large animals
   B. Types of food
   C. Kinds of soap
   D. Tiny living things that can cause disease

3. About how long are eggs boiled for hard-boiled eggs? (1 mark)
   A. About 5 hours
   B. One second
   C. About 10 minutes
   D. About 10 seconds

4. Why should broken glass be kept out of compost? (1 mark)
   A. It smells bad
   B. It does not rot and can cut people
   C. It rots too fast
   D. It makes the heap too wet

5. How can you make drinking water safe? (1 mark)
   A. Add soil
   B. Stir it with a stick
   C. Boil it and let it cool covered
   D. Leave it in the sun uncovered

6. What is used to make the arms of a scarecrow? (1 mark)
   A. A shorter stick tied across the pole
   B. A bucket of water
   C. A bottle
   D. Sand

7. When should the grass mulch be removed? (1 mark)
   A. After harvesting
   B. At sowing
   C. When seedlings begin to appear
   D. Never

8. What is refuse? (1 mark)
   A. Food
   B. Rubbish or waste
   C. Clean water
   D. Soap

9. Why do we weed around fruit plants? (1 mark)
   A. Weeds protect the stem
   B. Weeds add sugar
   C. Weeds give fruits
   D. Weeds take water and food from the plants

10. What does soil conservation mean? (1 mark)
   A. Selling soil to other farmers
   B. Looking after soil so that it stays healthy and stays in place
   C. Covering the soil with plastic
   D. Digging up all the soil on a farm

11. Which of these is a way of collecting water for the garden? (1 mark)
   A. Digging up rivers
   B. Cutting down trees
   C. Burning the roof
   D. Collecting rainwater from a roof

12. What should you do if a hole in a drip pipe is blocked? (1 mark)
   A. Pour hot oil in it
   B. Cut the pipe in half
   C. Throw away the whole system
   D. Clear it gently with a thin wire

13. Which fruit is a protective food? (1 mark)
   A. Rice
   B. Mango
   C. Chapati
   D. Ugali

14. What should you never do with a needle? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it in a pin cushion
   B. Use a thimble
   C. Thread it
   D. Put it in your mouth

15. Which is a correct step for cleaning gloves? (1 mark)
   A. Put them on again dirty
   B. Snatch them off by the fingers
   C. Pull them off from the wrist so the dirty outside does not touch skin
   D. Wear them wet

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain four benefits of conserving fuel. (4 marks)

17. Name three methods of cleaning the home environment. (3 marks)

18. Explain how measuring skills help you in tacking. (3 marks)

19. Explain what is meant by direct sowing. (2 marks)

20. Explain what thinning is and why it is done. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — It attracts rats and flies and smells bad
   Meat and fatty food attract pests and create a bad smell.

2. D — Tiny living things that can cause disease
   Germs cannot be seen without a microscope.

3. C — About 10 minutes
   Ten minutes of gentle boiling makes hard eggs.

4. B — It does not rot and can cut people
   Glass never rots and can injure anyone handling the compost.

5. C — Boil it and let it cool covered
   Boiling kills germs.

6. A — A shorter stick tied across the pole
   The cross stick forms shoulders and arms.

7. C — When seedlings begin to appear
   Seedlings need light.

8. B — Rubbish or waste
   Refuse means waste.

9. D — Weeds take water and food from the plants
   Weeds compete with the crop.

10. B — Looking after soil so that it stays healthy and stays in place
   Soil conservation protects the soil from being washed away and from losing its plant food.

11. D — Collecting rainwater from a roof
   Rainwater tanks store water for dry days.

12. D — Clear it gently with a thin wire
   A thin wire clears blockages without damaging the pipe.

13. B — Mango
   Mango has vitamins.

14. D — Put it in your mouth
   Needles are dangerous in the mouth.

15. C — Pull them off from the wrist so the dirty outside does not touch skin
   This prevents germs touching the skin.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Saves trees and forests, saves money, reduces smoke and illness, saves time looking for firewood.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sweeping, dusting, mopping and disposal of refuse (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each method.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Measuring gives correct stitch lengths, straight lines and correct size of the item.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sowing seeds straight into the place where the crop will grow until harvest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sowing seeds where the crop stays, 1 mark for no transplanting.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is removing extra seedlings. It gives the remaining plants space and reduces competition for water, light and food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 2 marks for reasons.
